# Almanac: Harbor View Condominium Association
Version: 2
Compiled: 2026-11-29
As of: 2026-11-29 (board local date)
Board folder: Board Documents
Sources: 17 processed, 0 excluded
Completeness: complete
Open conflicts: 1
Provisional items: 2
Model route: NAS local model

## At a glance

| Topic | Current rule | Since | Scheduled | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly fee and budget | $240 per unit per month | 2026-03-01 | none | adopted |
| Pets | Up to 2 per unit, registration required, no dog weight limit | 2025-04-15 | none | adopted |
| Renovations and work hours | Mon to Fri 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Sat 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., no Sun or holiday work | 2024-07-15 | none | adopted |
| Balconies and exterior fixtures | Fixtures need written approval; heat pumps allowed with conditions; barbecues and open flames prohibited (electric barbecues discussed, provisional) | 2019-05-01 | none | adopted |
| Quiet hours | Fri and Sat nights 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.; other nights 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. | 2026-10-01 | none | adopted |
| Rentals and leasing | Minimum lease 30 days | 2025-04-15 | none | adopted |
| Parking | Guest parking up to 48 hours; one assigned space per unit | 2025-10-01 | none | adopted |
| Electric vehicle charging | Allowed in assigned space with written board approval and a licensed electrician | 2026-01-20 (decision date) | none | adopted |
| Pool and amenities | 2026 season hours disputed: 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. or 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. | 2026 season | none | conflict |
| Vendor contracts | Landscaping: Bramblewick Grounds LLC, $1,450 per month, term ended 2026-03-31, non-renewal notice sent late | 2024-04-01 | none | adopted |
| Officers and elections | Board of President, Treasurer, Secretary; quorum two; Treasurer appointed 2025-09-10 | 2025-09-10 | none | adopted |
| Governance and amendments | Bylaws: two-thirds vote of owners. House rules: majority vote of the board | 2019-05-01 | none | adopted |

## Monthly fee and budget

Current rule: $240 per unit per month.
Effective: 2026-03-01
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2026-01-20, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2026-01-20.pdf: "the monthly common charge is set at $240 per unit, effective March 1, 2026"
Authority: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Monthly common charges are set by the board in the annual budget and take effect on the date the board states."

Superseded:
- 2025-03-01 to 2026-03-01: $225 per unit per month. Source: minutes-2025-01-23.pdf: "the monthly common charge is set at $225 per unit, effective March 1, 2025" (3-0)
- 2024-03-01 to 2025-03-01: $210 per unit per month. Source: minutes-2024-01-18.pdf: "the monthly common charge is set at $210 per unit, effective March 1, 2024" (3-0)
- Corrected: $230 stated in notice-2025-02-10-fees.pdf ("From March 1, 2025 the monthly common charge will be $230 per unit."). Correction in minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "the notice of February 10, 2025 stating $230 was in error. The adopted charge is $225 per unit."
- Proposed, not adopted: $235. Source: agenda-2025-01-23.pdf; amended in minutes-2025-01-23.pdf: "The proposed charge of $235 was amended."
- Informational, not a rule: newsletter-2025-12.pdf reports owners asking whether charges will reach $250; no proposal adopted.

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Pets

Current rule: Up to 2 pets per unit. Registration with management is required. No dog weight limit.
Effective: 2025-04-15 (decision date; no later effective date stated)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-04-15, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "each unit may keep a maximum of two (2) pets; the 35-pound limit for dogs is removed; registration with management is still required."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2025-04-15: One pet per unit; dogs may not exceed 35 pounds; all pets registered with management. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Each unit may keep one (1) pet. Dogs may not exceed 35 pounds."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisi

onal: none

## Renovations and work hours

Current rule: Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; Saturday 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.; no work on Sundays or holidays.
Effective: 2024-07-15
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2024-06-12, motion carried 3-0; restated in notice-2024-07-01-renovation-hours.pdf
Evidence: minutes-2024-06-12.docx: "amend House Rule 5 to permit renovation work on Saturdays from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., effective July 15, 2024."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2024-07-15: Monday to Friday 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.; no work on Saturdays, Sundays or holidays. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "No work is permitted on Saturdays, Sundays or holidays."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Balconies and exterior fixtures

Current rule: No fixtures, appliances or equipment on balconies or exterior walls without written board approval. Heat pump outdoor units are allowed with written approval if floor-mounted, not attached to the railing, and rated at no more than 60 dB(A). Barbecues and open flames are prohibited on balconies.
Effective: 2019-05-01 (fixture and barbecue rules); 2025-01-23 (heat pump rule, decision date)
Set by: Bylaws and house rules, 2019-05-01; board meeting minutes, 2025-01-23, motion carried 2-1 (heat pump rule)
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "No fixtures, appliances or equipment may be mounted on balconies or exterior walls without written board approval." Heat pump rule, minutes-2025-01-23.pdf: "heat pump outdoor units are permitted on balconies with written board approval, provided they are floor-mounted and not attached to the railing, and have a rated sound level of no more than 60 dB(A)."

Superseded:
- Heat pumps: not addressed before 2025-01-23 (discussed and tabled 2024-11-07, minutes-2024-11-07.pdf). No rule was adopted in that period.

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: The board leaned towards allowing electric barbecues at the 2026-06-18 meeting, with no vote taken; a motion was planned for the September agenda. Source: board-meeting-2026-06-18.m4a, 00:01:10: "So we all lean towards allowing electric barbecues. Let's not vote tonight." The 2019 prohibition remains the adopted rule.

## Quiet hours

Current rule: Friday and Saturday nights 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. Every other night 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.
Effective: 2026-10-01
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2026-09-15, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2026-09-15.docx: "amend House Rule 6 so that quiet hours on Friday and Saturday nights are 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m." and "Quiet hours on all other nights remain 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. Effective October 1, 2026."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2026-10-01: 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night, for Friday and Saturday nights as well. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Rentals and leasing

Current rule: Minimum lease term 30 days.
Effective: 2025-04-15 (decision date; minutes state "Effective immediately")
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-04-15, motion carried 2-1
Evidence: minutes-2025-04-15.docx: "amend House Rule 8 so that the minimum lease term is thirty (30) days. Effective immediately."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2025-04-15: Minimum lease term six months. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Units may not be leased for a term of less than six (6) months."
- Failed: a motion to permit leases of seven days or more did not carry (1-2), minutes-2025-04-15.docx. It changes no rule.

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Parking

Current rule: Guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 48 hours. Each unit has one assigned space.
Effective: 2025-10-01 (guest parking rule)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2025-09-10, motion carried 3-0 (guest parking rule); bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf (assigned space)
Evidence: minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "amend House Rule 9 so that guest vehicles may stay in guest park

ing for no more than 48 hours. Effective October 1, 2025." Assigned space, bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Each unit has one assigned space."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 to 2025-10-01: Guest vehicles up to 72 hours. Source: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "Guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 72 hours."

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Electric vehicle charging

Current rule: Owners may install an electric vehicle charger in their assigned parking space with written board approval. It must be installed by a licensed electrician at the owner's cost.
Effective: 2026-01-20 (decision date; no effective date stated)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2026-01-20, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: minutes-2026-01-20.pdf: "owners may install an electric vehicle charger in their assigned parking space with written board approval, installed by a licensed electrician at the owner's cost."

Superseded: none recorded
Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Pool and amenities

Current rule: Documents disagree on the pool hours for the 2026 season. The documents do not resolve which applies.
Effective: 2026 season
Set by: Not resolved (see Open conflicts)
Evidence: Earlier rule, bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "The pool is open 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily during the season, June 1 to September 15."

Superseded:
- 2019-05-01 onward, June 1 to September 15 season: 9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily. Whether the 2026 statements replaced it for the 2026 season is part of the conflict below.

Scheduled: none
Open conflicts:
- 2026 season hours, minutes-2025-09-10.pdf (adopted, 3-0): "for the 2026 season the pool is open 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily."
- 2026 season hours, notice-2026-05-01-pool.pdf (board notice): "Hours: 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily." The same notice states "The pool opens on June 1, 2026."
- A notice that disagrees with an adopted resolution does not replace it; the documents do not explain the difference.

Provisional: At the 2026-06-18 meeting a member questioned the notice's nine o'clock hours, deferred to a later meeting. Source: board-meeting-2026-06-18.m4a, 00:01:45: "Someone said the notice says nine pm, but I thought we said ten." No decision was recorded.

## Vendor contracts

Current rule: Landscaping services from Bramblewick Grounds LLC at $1,450 per month under the agreement signed 2024-01-25, term 2024-04-01 to 2026-03-31. The agreement renews for one-year terms unless written notice of non-renewal is given at least 60 days before the term ends, and any renewal increase is capped at 4%. The board decided not to renew.
Effective: 2024-04-01 (term start)
Set by: Board meeting minutes, 2024-01-18, award motion carried 3-0; signed contract, 2024-01-25; board decision not to renew, minutes-2025-09-10.pdf, motion carried 3-0
Evidence: contract-bramblewick-landscaping-2024.pdf: "This agreement runs from April 1, 2024 to March 31, 2026." Renewal: "renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the current term." Non-renewal notice: email-2026-02-02-landscaping.txt: "Please accept this message as written notice that Harbor View Condominium Association will not renew the Landscaping Services Agreement that ends on March 31, 2026."

Superseded: none recorded
Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none
Note: The non-renewal notice is dated 2026-02-02, after the due date of 2026-01-30 set by minutes-2025-09-10.pdf (see Open items). The documents record no agreement with Bramblewick Grounds LLC or any other landscaping contractor after 2026-03-31. This Skill does not judge whether the notice was legally effective.

## Officers and elections

Current rule: The board has three directors: President, Treasurer and Secretary. A quorum is two directors. A new Treasurer was appointed after the previous Treasurer resigned, to serve until the next annual meeting.
Effective: 2025-09-

10 (appointment; decision date)
Set by: Bylaws and house rules, 2019-05-01 (board composition and quorum); board meeting minutes, 2025-09-10, motion carried 3-0 (Treasurer appointment)
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "The Association is governed by a board of three directors: a President, a Treasurer and a Secretary. A quorum is two directors." minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "The Treasurer resigned. The board appointed a new Treasurer to serve until the next annual meeting."

Superseded: none recorded
Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Governance and amendments

Current rule: Bylaws (Part A) may be amended only by a two-thirds vote of unit owners at an annual meeting. House rules (Part B) may be amended by a majority vote of the board.
Effective: 2019-05-01
Set by: Bylaws and house rules, adopted by unit owners 2019-05-01
Evidence: bylaws-house-rules-2019.pdf: "These Bylaws (Part A) may be amended only by a two-thirds (2/3) vote of unit owners at an annual meeting." and "The House Rules (Part B) may be amended by a majority vote of the board."

Superseded: none recorded
Scheduled: none
Open conflicts: none
Provisional: none

## Changelog

## v2, 2026-11-29
- Rebuilt from 17 files. New since v1: minutes-2026-09-15.docx.
- Changed: Quiet hours. Friday and Saturday nights now 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m., effective 2026-10-01 (adopted 3-0 on 2026-09-15); other nights unchanged at 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.
- No other rule, scope, effective date, authority or status changed from v1.
- Open conflicts: 1 (Pool and amenities, 2026 season hours), unchanged from v1.
- Provisional: 2 (electric barbecues, from board-meeting-2026-06-18.m4a; pool hours question from the same recording).
- No exclusions.

End of almanac v2.
